name: Saturation
briefing:
## Situation
Night, heavy rain, visibility about 5 km. A large, mixed incursion is expected: several swarms, decoys and single drones at once, with birds, civilian drones, our own patrol drones and a friendly helicopter in the same airspace. Rain cuts radar range.
## Mission
Defeat the drones that threaten Bridge Post. You have fewer interceptor rounds than hostile drones: prioritise, and use the jammer and spoofer on groups. Do not engage the friendly helicopter or our patrols.

## Intel
Axes are uncertain. The high, RF-loud contacts are likely decoys; the low groups are the attack. A smuggler may try to cross during the confusion.
